ctx.x: The Congo Club was located in the Norwood(?) Hotel, 555 East Adams Boulevard. It was like... East Adams Street, yeah. It was like the place. Slim Jenkins was the owner, and downstairs in the Norwood(?) Hotel, they had this very fine club, and it was called the Congo Club. Now, the Congo Club... When the big acts left the theatre, they would come into the Congo Club and work the following week, see.
